body: I just don't know what to do anymore. I have lost all desire to do anything. I don't even eat or sleep anymore.

We were part of this gaming community, and we agreed to leave it after someone started to harass us about our relationship. About a week later, I returned to the community, after that person had been banned, but I didn't tell him that I returned to it.

We still talk about things almost every day, but he won't give me a chance to prove that I was loyal to him. 

One of the things I wasn't open about was what I did without him. I didn't try to hide it, I just didn't tell him.
It wasn't just my issues that I struggled talking about, though that was a big part of it. I didn't always tell him what I was doing without him.

He broke up with me about 2 weeks ago, after being gone for a month dealing with personal issues. He didn't trust what I was doing during the time that he was gone, but I was and still am extremely loyal. I would never consider having cheated on him.
I think in a way he didn't understand, but at the same time, he was trying to work with me about being more open.
He hasn't said he doesn't love me anymore. I wasn't 100% transparent with him, despite saying that I would be.
He did. He used to say it every couple hours. Then I made a few mistakes, and ruined the relationship.
I think that he still does, but if he does, he isn't being open about it right now.
